mentions.name: DecisionPoint
mentions.description: A modern web app for the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP), a structured decision-making framework. It models a decision by organising it into a goal, criteria, and alternatives; uses pairwise comparisons to assign weights to the criteria and then the alternatives; and produces a ranking of the alternatives by preference.
mentions.source_excerpt: A modern web app for the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP), which is a structured decision making framework. The AHP models a decision by organising it into a goal, criteria, and alternatives. Pairwise comparisons are used to assign weights to the criteria, and subsequently the alternatives, producing a ranking of the alternatives by preference.
